newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine May public service consumption up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine May public service consumption up 15 pct.

text.p: Argentine consumption of public services in May rose 15.4 percent on the same month of 1996 and 5.1 percent on the previous month, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
The public service indicator for the first five months of the year showed a 12.6 percent increase in consumption on the same period last year.

Electricity generation rose 10.3 percent on May 1996 and for the first five months was up 8.1 percent on January-May last year. Natural gas output was up 13.1 percent May-on-May and for the first five months was up 15.7 percent.
Telephone usage in May versus May was up 7.0 percent for urban calls and 28.1 percent for long-distance.
